name.description: The human-readable name of the data element.

delegate_descriptor_id.description: The descriptor ID identifying the data element type from an extension.

default_value.description: The default value when the data element returns no value.

settings.description: A JSON-encoded string of settings for the data element.

storage_duration.description: How long the data element value persists.

force_lower_case.description: Whether to force the value to lowercase.

clean_text.description: Whether to clean whitespace from the value.

enabled.description: Whether the data element is enabled.
